questions.question: Choose the most appropriate SYNONYM for the word 'PRUDENT':
questions.explanation: Rule RC-01 ke mutabiq, target word 'Prudent' ek ADJECTIVE hai (meaning: wise, showing good judgment). Option B ('Judicious') bhi Adjective hai jo same meaning express karta hai. Option A ('Prudence') Noun hai aur Option D ('Cautiously') Adverb hai, isliye POS mismatch ke kaaran eliminate ho jate hain. Option C ('Rash') iska antonym hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: The Same Part-of-Speech Concord Law
questions.hint: Check karein ki 'Prudent' kis grammatical class se belong karta hai. Noun ya Adverb options ko turant hata dein.

questions.question: In the sentence: "The division bench delivered a SOUND judgment on the constitutional dispute.", what is the exact SYNONYM of 'SOUND'?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-02 ke anusaar, 'SOUND' ek polysemic word hai. Judicial decisions ke context mein 'sound' ka matlab acoustic noise ya hearing nahi hota, balki 'legally valid, robust aur well-reasoned' hota hai. Isliye Option B ('Valid') hi sahi synonym hai. Option A aur C secondary literal sense ke distractor traps hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-02: Contextual Sense Freezing in Polysemy
questions.hint: Sentence mein judgment ki baat ho rahi hai. Judgment kaan se sunne wala shor nahi hota, balki tarkik aur kanooni roop se thos hota hai.

questions.question: What is the true ANTONYM of 'DISINTERESTED' when used in reference to an arbitrator?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-09 ke tehat, 'Disinterested' ka matlab 'impartial ya neutral' (nishpaksh) hota hai, na ki 'bored'. Iska exact polar opposite 'Biased' (Option C) ya 'Prejudiced' hoga. Option D ('Impartial') iska synonym hai, aur Option A ('Uninterested') common vocabulary confusion trap hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Negative Prefix False Friends Neutralizer
questions.hint: Disinterested hone ka matlab hai ki vyakti ka koi niji faayda nahi hai (neutral hai). Neutral ka opposite kya hoga?

questions.question: Select the correct ANTONYM of the word 'INVALUABLE':
questions.explanation: Rule RC-09 ke mutabiq, 'Invaluable' ka matlab 'beyond value / priceless' (itna keemti jiska mol na lagaya ja sake) hota hai. Iska opposite 'cheap' ya 'valuable' nahi, balki 'Worthless' (Option B) hota hai. Option A aur C iske synonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Negative Prefix False Friends Neutralizer
questions.hint: Prefix 'in-' yahan negative nahi hai balki 'beyond' signify karta hai. Agar koi cheez anmol hai, toh uska opposite bina kisi mulya ki cheez hogi.

questions.question: Which word represents the true polar ANTONYM of 'COLOSSAL'?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-03 ke tehat, 'Colossal' ek extreme size adjective hai (meaning: gigantic/immense). Iska opposite continuum ke doosre extreme par 'Tiny' ya 'Minute' (Option C) hoga. Option B ('Immense') iska synonym hai aur Option A/D scale ke intermediate points hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Gradable Scale Extremes vs Intermediate Degrees
questions.hint: Colossal ka matlab bohot vishalkay hota hai. Scale ke extreme point ka opposite extreme chhota hoga.

questions.question: Choose the most appropriate SYNONYM for 'MITIGATE' in: "The government took steps to MITIGATE public hardship."
questions.explanation: Target verb 'Mitigate' ka matlab dard, takleef ya sankat ko kam karna hota hai. Option A ('Alleviate') iska exact synonym hai. Option B ('Aggravate') iska antonym hai, Option C ('Militate') ek lookalike verb hai, aur Option D ('Mitigation') noun form hai jo POS concord todta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01 (POS Concord) & Rule RC-10 (Distractor Exclusion)
questions.hint: Kast ko kam karne ke liye kaunsa verb use hota hai? Noun form (-tion) ko pehle hi eliminate kar dein.

questions.question: Which of the following word pairs is a COMPLEMENTARY (binary) antonym pair?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-04 ke anusaar, complementary antonyms mutually exclusive hote hain jinme koi intermediate state nahi hoti. Koyi court order ya toh 'Valid' hoga ya 'Void' (null). A, B, aur D sabhi gradable scales hain (jaise Fast-Slow ke beech normal ya moderate speed ho sakti hai).
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Binary Complementary Opposition Law
questions.hint: Aisi jodi chunein jisme koi middle ground na ho—ek sach ho toh doosra 100% jhooth ho.

questions.question: What is the exact ANTONYM of 'TACITURN'?
questions.explanation: 'Taciturn' (Adjective) ka matlab kam bolne wala ya chup rehne wala hota hai. Option A ('Reticent'), B ('Laconic') aur D ('Reserved') teeno iske direct SYNONYMS hain. Iska polar opposite 'Garrulous' ya 'Loquacious' (Option C: bohot baatuni) hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03 (Scale Extremes) & Rule RC-12 (Prompt Check: Antonym)
questions.hint: Options A, B, aur D sabhi kam bolne ke bare mein hain. Sirf ek option bohot zyada bolne ko represent karta hai.

questions.question: Which prefix correctly attaches to 'LOGICAL' to form its standard antonym?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-08 ke mutabiq, Latin negative prefix 'in-' liquid consonant 'L' ke aage assimilate hokar 'il-' ban jata hai (il- + logical = Illogical; il- + legal = Illegal). *Unlogical ya *dislogical English mein non-standard hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Phonetic Prefix Assimilation Rules
questions.hint: Jab base word 'L' se start hota hai, toh Latin prefix 'in-' badalkar 'il-' ho jata hai.

questions.question: Which word is a positive, commendatory SYNONYM for someone who firmly sticks to their purpose, unlike the pejorative word 'stubborn'?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-07 ke anusaar, 'Stubborn', 'Obstinate', 'Pigheaded', aur 'Mulish' sabhi pejorative (negative) tone rakhte hain jo anavashyak ariyallpan darshate hain. Jabki 'Resolute' (Option B) ek dignified aur praise-worthy (positive) determination ko express karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Tone & Connotation Polarity Concord
questions.hint: Tareef ke liye kaunsa word use hoga? A, C, aur D teeno burai ya aalochana ke shabd hain.

questions.question: What is the precise paired ANTONYM of 'ZENITH'?
questions.explanation: 'Zenith' (Noun) ka matlab sarvochch shikhar ya highest point hota hai. Iska exact paired antonym 'Nadir' (Option C: lowest point ya pataal) hota hai. Options A, B, aur D teeno iske synonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Gradable Scale Extremes vs Intermediate Degrees
questions.hint: Apex, Pinnacle aur Acme teeno choti (top) ko bolte hain. Bottom-most point ko kya kehte hain?

questions.question: In criminal jurisprudence, what is the polar opposite (ANTONYM) of 'EXCULPATE'?
questions.explanation: 'Exculpate' (Ex- + culpa/blame) ka matlab dosh-mukt karna ya nirdosh saabit karna hota hai. Options A ('Exonerate'), B ('Absolve'), aur D ('Acquit') iske synonyms hain. Iska polar opposite 'Incriminate' (Option C: dosh lagana ya apradh mein fasana) hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Binary Complementary Opposition Law & RC-12
questions.hint: Exculpate ka matlab dosh se azaad karna hai. Dosh mein phansane wale verb ko identify karein.
